objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to creation, editing, release, versioning, distribution, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1–4) within the document pyramid.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in document naming (e.g., RL for guideline).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, 4-digit consecutive number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the released version is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration (default 3 years) defining how long a released version remains valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration (default 10 years) for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data or other documents maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT application references maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Company or client scope maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Organizational or geographic scope maintained in document properties.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata printed into the document via TAG technology.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, managed independently but released with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary, non-controlled document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Switch indicating whether the additional information is released and published.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal to amend an existing released document, created without affecting the document's current content or version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g., Created, Planned, Completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before a document's validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate (put out of force) a released document and archive it along with its attachments.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its content and authorizations.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in one or more roles.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language setting of the user that determines document display language.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign collective read or change authorizations and distribution memberships.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons who are notified or requested for acknowledgement upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that routes tasks through defined steps (e.g., Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant or organizational client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be controlled.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity (e.g., department, location) to which documents can be linked.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A user- and role-specific view presenting relevant documents, tasks, and evaluation information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: A role-specific evaluation report providing filtered search and status information about documents.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g., Status Report, Search, Acknowledgement Status).

attributes.name: selection_parameters
attributes.description: Configurable parameters and criteria that filter the report results.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of a document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval process is initiated by the author or a co-author, beginning the 3-step release workflow.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator step) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication during the release workflow step.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when changes are made to content, attributes, or attachments.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment's content is changed, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: A new non-controlled additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, marking it as completed and notifying the proposal creator.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser) confirms the extended validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and initiate the override workflow.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override workflow is completed, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The reactivation workflow is confirmed, creating a new version of the archived document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by e-mail notification upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual users for a document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language, then checked and released with workflow support.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is permanently deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

o2o.description: A document has zero or more controlled attachments that are versioned and released with it.
A document has zero or more additional information objects that are not subject to the document's release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to exactly one document and is displayed within that document.
A document can reference another document (e.g., local extension referencing original in multi-client system).
A document type can have one or more defined templates selectable at creation time.
Each document has a distribution list specifying user groups and persons for notification or acknowledgement.
A document can be linked to organizational units via its properties.
In a multi-client system, a document's visibility is specified per client.
A distribution list contains assigned user groups for email or acknowledgement distribution.
A distribution list contains directly assigned persons for email or acknowledgement distribution.
A user group contains individual users who inherit the group's authorizations.
A user is assigned a role on a document (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator) via document properties.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.
An override request is linked to the document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request selects the archived document to be reactivated.
